description: Dataset for: Scan-to-BIM-to-Sim: Automated reconstruction of digital and simulation models from point clouds with applications on bridges is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Yunping Fang, Jelena Ninic (University of Birmingham). The dataset consists of raw point cloud data (.pcd file) of an Aqueduct Bridge obtained through terrestrial laser scanning. The bridge is located on the A38 near the University of Birmingham (C3W6+RX Birmingham) and carries a canal in the centre, allowing pedestrians to pass on both sides. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
